## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.7.2.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: a sentence on IEs the update does not include follows the two cited ones in V15.13.0 (absent in V15.0.0); the cited ones are unchanged to V18.11.0; graded as a requirement: "The AMF responds with a RAN CONFIGURATION UPDATE ACKNOWLEDGE" is the answer of a Class 1 procedure to an update the AMF takes; Rel-19: in V19.4.0 the same words are a bullet under "If the RAN Configuration Update procedure is executed between the NG-RAN node and the AMF")
- TS 38.413 8.7.2.3 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-RAN-CONFIG-UPDATE-ACK.md).
